architecture.rule: Retired executors may remain only as historical provenance and may never be required for current completion or production truth.

invariants: GREEN CANDIDATE MEANS PROMOTE TO PRODUCTION
RETIRED EXECUTORS ARE NEVER ACTIVE DEPENDENCIES

registeredObligations.expected: Every active Powerhouse runtime component remains inside the governed shared monthly cost envelope.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Current budget envelope, period usage, remaining capacity and run decision are present in the canonical Powerhouse cost projection.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Defer optional work, preserve protected interrupts and re-evaluate after the next verified cost snapshot.
registeredObligations.legacyProvenance: Former Make-scenario accounting is LEGACY_RETIRED_PATH and must not participate in current run decisions.

registeredObligations.expected: Every governed AI provider call records exact returned token usage and optional AI work is deferred when the shared 10000-token monthly envelope is exhausted.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The append-only provider usage ledger contains only sanitized token counters keyed by request id; the dashboard distinguishes RECORDED from UNMETERED components and the deterministic envelope uses the strictest credit or token state.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep the valid user outcome available when metering storage is transiently unavailable, mark coverage unavailable, retry bounded writeback and defer optional AI once verified usage reaches the limit.

registeredObligations.expected: Every discovered active Powerhouse/Supabase/GitHub/Buffer/Notion runtime component is classified and represented once in the daily normalized cost ledger.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The catalog contains every current active runtime inventory key once and unknown optional components are BUDGET_DEFERRED.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Refresh the active runtime inventory, deduplicate by component key and quarantine invalid or contradictory metering.
registeredObligations.legacyProvenance: Historical Make scenarios are LEGACY_RETIRED_PATH and excluded from active inventory.

registeredObligations.expected: Every daily active-runtime inventory refresh produces exactly one governed portfolio decision: SAFE_OPTIMIZATION_CANDIDATE, VERIFIED_NO_ACTION, or BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY, with cost/outcome evidence and Powerhouse shared-current-state visibility.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The daily decision records SAFE_OPTIMIZATION_CANDIDATE, VERIFIED_NO_ACTION, or BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY with inventory fingerprint, cost/outcome evidence and current Powerhouse/Supabase shared-memory visibility for every material change.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Refresh the active inventory, reuse known fingerprints, deduplicate the candidate and decision, verify no duplicate external side effect exists, and resume recovery until the portfolio outcome is verified or a valid hard boundary remains.

registeredObligations.expected: Every material budget decision and verified optimization outcome is persisted through the current Powerhouse/Supabase shared-memory writeback path and is readable from current shared context.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: The current shared-memory event contains trace, correlation, fingerprint, evidence and protected metrics; a readback from the supported Powerhouse/Supabase context confirms visibility.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Retry the current supported writeback at most twice per hypothesis, then retain locally verified evidence and resume through the same shared-memory recovery path.
registeredObligations.legacyProvenance: BG168/BG167 Make-based execution is LEGACY_RETIRED_PATH and must never be invoked.

registeredObligations.expected: Every repository writer may be marked operationally certified only after its verified outcome is persisted through the current Powerhouse/Supabase shared-memory path and is visible in current shared state.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Exact verification SHA, real writer candidate PR, immutable shadow evidence, exact-head and path-policy verification, bounded impact policy and current shared-memory readback are required before COMPLETED.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep certification AWAITING_OUTCOME, retain immutable evidence, rerun only the missing safe verification step, write back through the current supported path and do not mark VERIFIED until all evidence is complete.

registeredObligations.expected: Every daily cycle and every relevant Supabase schema or performance change produces one comparable performance evidence snapshot and one governed trend decision without direct production mutation.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Each finding has a stable finding-key, comparable table/workload/p95 measurement and timestamp; two consecutive qualifying observations are required before CANDIDATE_INDEX, and any accepted change is remeasured on the exact production SHA before outcome learning is accepted.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep the obligation AWAITING_OUTCOME, collect the missing comparable evidence, do not mutate production directly from a linter finding, and resume only through the governed candidate and exact production verification path.

registeredObligations.expected: The cost dashboard and API remain private, read-only and fail closed for anonymous or unauthorized users.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Anonymous receives 401, wrong role receives 403, authorized app_metadata role receives sanitized aggregate data only.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Block access and rollback the candidate if authorization, no-store, CSP, noindex or data-minimization checks fail.

registeredObligations.expected: The dashboard uses the newest verified canonical Powerhouse/Supabase projection without exposing raw prompts, CRM payloads or secrets.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Projection exposes source timestamp and fingerprint and selects the newest valid aggregate source from the supported runtime.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep the last verified projection, mark freshness visibly and reject malformed or untrusted records.

registeredObligations.expected: Every material Powerhouse change remains active until the exact candidate is protected-delivered, production-read back, capability-visible and canonically learned under one durable obligation.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Identity-bound CANDIDATE_TESTS, PROTECTED_DELIVERY, PRODUCTION_IDENTITY, FUNCTIONAL_READBACK, OBLIGATIONS_COMPLETE, CAPABILITY_HANDOFF and LEARNING_WRITEBACK evidence must all be append-only and trusted before LIVE_VERIFIED.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Keep partial outcomes active, retain the same coalesced candidate obligation across retries or days, wait only on a proven external boundary with a complete recovery packet, and resume automatically when new trusted evidence arrives.

registeredObligations.expected: A green dashboard candidate is promoted through the canonical protected GitHub/Netlify production-promotion path and verified on the exact production SHA.
registeredObligations.evidencePolicy: Exact candidate SHA, CI, Netlify production deploy identity, anonymous-denial smoke and protected regression checks are green.
registeredObligations.recoveryPolicy: Rollback to the last-known-good production tree when an exact-SHA or protected-metric check regresses.
